|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E2 of [[The Camp (V)]] (version 3 of 4). The image is the Players Committee card image, which prints this text. Versions in date order: [[The Camp (V)]] (original, release sheet of 15 December 2010); [[The Camp (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1, PC website card list, by 21 July 2012); '''this page''' (PC-E2, Players Committee card image, uploaded 25 February 2013, the same words as the original); [[The Camp (V) (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3, Master List of 27 April 2013, the same words as the original, the current text).
* '''Original''' ([[The Camp (V)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 7.2 release sheet (official text as of 15 December 2010): “Unless your [Reflections 2] objective on table, deploy on table. If [Permanent Weapon] Maul in battle at a site, and you have no unique (•) character of ability > 3 (except Luke of ability = 4) there, lightsabers there may not be ‘swung’ twice. Once per game, may ▲ one K’lor’slug or a [Setup] card. [Immune to Alter]”.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock7_2">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_2.pdf#page=4 Virtual Block 7.2 release sheet] ("Official text as of December 15, 2010"; PDF made 23 December 2010), Light Side p. 4, page 4, slip 26 (position on the sheet; the slip prints no number). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261016180935/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_2.pdf#page=4 Internet Archive]</ref> The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints this text again (Light Side, p. 30). Under the ruling of 11 November 2026 (every publication is a version), that copy is its own version, PC-E3 ([[The Camp (V) (Errata 3)]]), and the current text.<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=30, page 30. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=30 Internet Archive]</ref> The release-sheet slip prints no slip number.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[The Camp (V) (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 January 2013) reads “characters” for “character” (it writes the icons as “[Reflections II]” and “[Permenant Weapon]”, drops the uniqueness dot and writes ▲ out as “take … into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle”, which is notation only): “Unless your [Reflections II] objective on table, deploy on table. If [Permenant Weapon] Maul in battle at a site, and you have no unique () characters of ability > 3 (except Luke of ability = 4) there, lightsabers there may not be 'swung' twice. Once per game, may take one K'lor'slug or a [Setup] card into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. (Immune to Alter.)”.<ref name="cl-1272_26-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock7Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205229/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-12-11] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111152155/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive); the Virtual master list (VMasterType) shows the same text from 2012-07-21 to 2013-01-11; the captures of 14 March and 16 May 2013 carry no game text</ref> The card list was generated from the Players Committee's Holotable card data (research R7, 11 November 2026), so this wording is a transcription the PC published, not a separately announced errata; it is listed because it was published.
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB7-L-thecamp-pre.gif]]) prints the original release-sheet text ([[The Camp (V)]]) again, word for word: “Unless your [Reflections 2] objective on table, deploy on table. If [Permanent Weapon] Maul in battle at a site, and you have no unique (•) character of ability > 3 (except Luke of ability = 4) there, lightsabers there may not be ‘swung’ twice. Once per game, may ▲ one K’lor’slug or a [Setup] card. [Immune to Alter]” The image is dated only by its upload to the Players Committee's server: the Apache listing of the Virtual7-Light card-image folder gives every file there the same time, 25 February 2013, 11:34<ref name="pcdir-Virtual7-Light">Players Committee server, [https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034736/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual7-Light/large/?C=M;O=A directory listing of cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual7-Light/large/] sorted by date, as captured 18 August 2019 (Internet Archive)</ref>. That is a bulk upload date, so the image may have been made earlier; it is placed at that date (ruling of 11 November 2026: what was uploaded last counts as the last version). It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat). The PC card image prints the slip number “P•01” at the bottom right, which the release-sheet slip does not.
* '''PC-E3''' ([[The Camp (V) (Errata 3)]]): the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Light Side, p. 30)<ref name="ml-ls" /> prints the original release-sheet text ([[The Camp (V)]]) again, word for word: “Unless your [Reflections 2] objective on table, deploy on table. If [Permanent Weapon] Maul in battle at a site, and you have no unique (•) character of ability > 3 (except Luke of ability = 4) there, lightsabers there may not be ‘swung’ twice. Once per game, may ▲ one K’lor’slug or a [Setup] card. [Immune to Alter]” It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat of an earlier text), and, as the latest dated text, it is the current text. Its image is the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1272-26-front-master.png]]). The Master List slip prints no slip number (the release-sheet slip and the PC card image do).
